args.lesson: Verdict STOP: 0/3 candidates. What worked: Discourse JSON endpoints (categories.json, /c/<slug>/<id>.json, search.json, /t/<id>.json) were readable without an account, and listing the categories first found the right category (Marketplace) in one call. What failed: the hypothesis. The Ghost Marketplace is supply-heavy (28/30 latest topics are vendor ads; Ghost Experts sell migrations, e.g. USD 999/year retainers). Buyer requests are rare (latest migration one 2025-04), and they ask for theme/integration builds that need live site access, not offline import repair. Next time: before building inventory for a community, count buyer posts against vendor posts in its hiring category. If vendors dominate and requests are older than 6 months, pick another market. Do not reopen Ghost without a classified inbound request.
